basic_info.description: Welcome to 18 Orben Place, a beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home on a quiet, tree-lined street in Pacific Heights' Upper Fillmore neighborhood.  With a 99 Walk Score and just half a block from Fillmore Street, this charming home offers easy walking access to the city's most sought-after boutiques, trendy cafes, renowned gourmet restaurants, and beautiful parks.  The main level offers 11-foot ceilings in the spacious great room, which opens onto a private, sunlit deck perfect for entertaining or unwinding. The kitchen includes refurbished marble countertops, an AGA gas range, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and Italian ceramic floor tile. This level also has a powder room. Ascend the elegant staircase with its curving balustrade to discover 2 bedrooms and a remodeled marble bathroom with separate soaking tub and shower.  There is a laundry room on this level.  Additional highlights include a one-car garage, large storage area, designer light fixtures, new paint throughout, refinished hardwood floors, new furnace and abundant natural  light.
